title: 第二十四章 融剑成道，天剑惊变
content_zh:
死亡沙漠边缘，一处隐蔽的地下溶洞中。

    五彩的光芒如同梦幻的丝带，在溶洞中交织流转，将原本昏暗的空间映照得如同仙境。光芒的中心，林墨盘膝而坐，那枚蕴含着精纯五行本源和剑意的五行剑髓，正悬浮在他眉心之前，缓缓旋转，不断逸散出丝丝缕缕的五彩光晕，融入他的体内。

    他的气息，此刻正处于一种极其玄妙的状态。

    《无始剑经》那斩断一切、破灭万法的“无始”剑意，与剑皇传承那浩瀚、堂皇、包容万物的“皇道”剑意，如同两条奔腾的巨龙，在他体内激烈地碰撞、交织，试图吞噬对方，却又被五行剑髓散发出的柔和力量所调和、缓冲，形成一种微妙的平衡。

    “融剑术”的法门，在林墨心间流淌。他以自身万道剑体为熔炉，以强大的神魂为引，以五行剑髓为媒介，小心翼翼地引导着这两股截然不同、却又同样强大的剑道力量，进行着艰难的融合。

    汗水如同小溪般，从他额头滑落，浸湿了衣袍。他的脸色时而涨红，时而苍白，身体不时微微颤抖，显然承受着极大的痛苦。两种顶级剑道的碰撞，哪怕有五行剑髓调和，其凶险程度，也远超常人想象。稍有不慎，便是剑意反噬，经脉尽断，甚至魂飞魄散的下场。

    溶洞外，洛璃和楚狂歌一左一右，警惕地为林墨护法。他们已经在这里守候了整整五天。

    “这小子，都五天了，还没动静，不会出什么事了吧？”楚狂歌有些焦躁地来回踱步。他神魂的创伤，在洛璃给的疗伤圣药帮助下，已经恢复了大半，但依旧有些虚弱。

    “相信他。”洛璃盘膝坐在洞口，闭目调息，语气平静，但紧握剑柄的手指，却暴露了她内心的紧张，“他是万道剑体，又得到了剑皇的认可，一定能成功的。”

    就在这时——

    嗡——！

    一股难以形容的、仿佛蕴含着宇宙至理的剑意波动，如同涟漪般，从溶洞深处扩散开来！

    这股剑意，既非纯粹的“无始”，也非纯粹的“皇道”，而是一种全新的、仿佛融合了两者优点、却又超越了二者的、更加包容、更加深邃、更加……可怕的剑意！

    在这股剑意的影响下，溶洞周围的岩石，竟然开始自动分解、重组，化作一柄柄粗糙的石剑，插在地面上，仿佛在朝拜它们的君王！

    “成功了！”洛璃猛地睁开双眼，眸中闪过惊喜之色。

    楚狂歌也停下了脚步，张大嘴巴，看向溶洞深处，感受着那股令人心悸的剑意，喃喃道：“乖乖……这小子……真的做到了？”

    溶洞深处，五彩光芒缓缓收敛，尽数没入林墨体内。他缓缓睁开眼睛，眸中深处，仿佛有两柄无形的神剑，在交相辉映，一者斩断万物，一者包容万法。
content_en:
On the edge of the Death Desert, in a hidden underground cave.

    The colorful lights are like dreamy ribbons, intertwining and flowing in the cave, making the originally dark space look like a fairyland. In the center of the light, Lin Mo sat cross-legged. The Five Elements Sword Essence, which contained the pure Five Elements origin and sword intention, was suspended in front of his eyebrows. It slowly rotated, continuously emitting strands of colorful halo and integrating into his body.

    His aura was in an extremely mysterious state at the moment.

    The "Wu Shi" sword intention of the "Wu Shi Sword Sutra" that cuts off everything and destroys all methods, and the vast, majestic, and inclusive "Imperial Way" sword intention inherited by the Sword Emperor, are like two galloping dragons, violently colliding and intertwining in his body, trying to devour each other, but they are reconciled and buffered by the gentle power emanating from the Five Elements Sword Marrow, forming a delicate balance.

    The method of "sword fusion" flows in Lin Mo's heart. He used his Ten Thousand Sword Body as a melting pot, his powerful soul as a guide, and the Five Elements Sword Marrow as a medium to carefully guide these two completely different but equally powerful sword forces to carry out a difficult fusion.

    Sweat fell from his forehead like a stream, soaking his clothes. His face was sometimes flushed and sometimes pale, and his body was trembling slightly from time to time, obviously suffering great pain. The collision between two top swordsmanships, even if it is harmonized by the Five Elements Sword Marrow, is far more dangerous than ordinary people imagine. If you are not careful, your sword will backfire, your meridians will be severed, and your soul will be scattered.

    Outside the cave, Luo Li and Chu Kuangge were on the left and right, guarding Lin Mo vigilantly. They have been waiting here for five days.

    "This kid, it's been five days and there's still no movement. Is something going to happen?" Chu Kuangge paced back and forth anxiously. With the help of the healing medicine given by Luo Li, most of the wounds on his soul have recovered, but he is still a little weak.

    "Believe him." Luo Li sat cross-legged at the entrance of the cave, closed her eyes and adjusted her breath. Her tone was calm, but the fingers clenching the sword hilt revealed her inner nervousness. "He is a Ten Thousand Dao Sword Body, and he has been recognized by the Sword Emperor. He will definitely succeed."

    Just then——

    Buzz—!

    An indescribable wave of sword intent that seemed to contain the truth of the universe spread out from the depths of the cave like ripples!

    This sword intention is neither pure "beginningless" nor pure "imperial way", but a brand new sword intention that seems to combine the advantages of both, but transcends both, is more inclusive, deeper, and more... terrifying!

    Under the influence of this sword intent, the rocks around the cave began to automatically decompose and reorganize, turning into rough stone swords that were inserted into the ground, as if worshiping their king!

    "Successful!" Luo Li opened her eyes suddenly, surprise flashing in her eyes.

    Chu Kuangge also stopped, opened his mouth wide, looked into the depths of the cave, felt the heart-stopping sword intent, and murmured: "My dear... this kid... really did it?"

    Deep in the cave, the colorful rays of light slowly converged and disappeared into Lin Mo's body. He slowly opened his eyes, and in the depths of his eyes, there seemed to be two invisible divine swords reflecting each other, one cutting off all things, the other containing all things.
title_en: Chapter 24: Fusion of swords into Taoism, the Heavenly Sword undergoes a sudden change
